tools.name: list_technologies
tools.title: List HLG technologies
tools.description: List the six electrical functions HLG engineers into laminated glass — HEAT (electrically heated interlayers), SENSE (embedded RTD temperature sensing), SHIELD (EMI/RFI shielding), CONDUCT (transparent conductors), SWITCH (switchable smart glazing), CONNECT (integrated antennas). Returns slug, headline, lead copy, validated spec ranges, and page path for each.

tools.name: get_technology
tools.title: Get technology detail
tools.description: Retrieve the full public engineering description for one HLG technology function by slug or code — e.g. 'electrically-heated-interlayers' or 'HEAT', 'embedded-temperature-sensing' or 'SENSE'. Returns headline, lead, all page sections with bullets, validated spec ranges, closing position, and the engineering-review CTA.

tools.name: search_technical_library
tools.title: Search technical library
tools.description: Search the HLG Technical Library coverage by keyword. The V1 library is a framework: HLG maintains an expanding library of engineering resources covering the design and integration of electrical functionality into laminated glass, and technical papers and application notes are coming soon. Returns matching resource topics; no papers are published yet.

query.description: Keyword matched against resource topics, e.g. 'busbar', 'RTD', 'EMI'. Omit to list all topics.

tools.name: get_application_mapping
tools.title: Get application mapping
tools.description: Check how HLG markets (Aerospace, Defense, Automotive, Rail & Transportation, Off-Road & Commercial Equipment, Architectural & Smart Glass), integration solutions, and the six technology functions (HEAT, SENSE, SHIELD, CONDUCT, SWITCH, CONNECT) map to each other. Filter by market slug or technology slug/code.

market.description: Market slug or name fragment, e.g. 'aerospace', 'rail'. Omit for all markets.

technology.description: Technology slug or code fragment, e.g. 'HEAT', 'electrically-heated-interlayers'. Omit for all.
